findings.title: [security] odf/descriptors.c:1899 heap-buffer-overflow in gf_odf_ac4_cfg_alternative_info · Issue #3295 · gpac/gpac
findings.summary_md: Researcher sigdevel reported the heap buffer overflow (CVE-2025-60480) on 14 July 2025 via GitHub issue #3295, before the story's first_seen of 2026-10-17. The advisory describes a crafted AC-4 audio stream triggering a read past a 784-byte heap allocation at odf/descriptors.c:1899 in GPAC MP4Box 2.5-DEV-rev1593. Commit e02d1fd (15 July 2025) closed the issue as completed.

findings.title: Security Advisory: CVE-2025-60476 - Heap Use-After-Free in GPAC MP4Box AC-4 Descriptor Cleanup · Issue #3293
findings.summary_md: GitHub issue #3293 (CVE-2025-60476), published 2025-07-14, documents a heap use-after-free in the AC-4 descriptor cleanup path at odf/descriptors.c, tied to the same AC-4 parser family. The original disclosure predates the 2026-10-17 story timestamp by over a year.

findings.title: Security Advisory: CVE-2025-60470 - Out-of-Bounds Read in GPAC MP4Box AC-4 Parser · Issue #3294
findings.summary_md: GitHub issue #3294 (CVE-2025-60470) from 2025-07-14 reports an out-of-bounds read in the AC-4 parser, part of the same disclosure batch covering CVE-2025-60469, 60470, 60476, and 60480. All four were filed on 14 July 2025 and resolved in commit e02d1fd.
